title: Finite scalar transposes are coordinates of the strict tensor cone
statement: For arbitrary integral cochain complexes P,Q on W, let T be their direct-sum total tensor and D the actual finite quotient tensor tower. The explicit quotient augmentation followed by IntegralAmbient.tensorTowerIso is a strict cone with vertex T. For every n, its nth component equals the transpose under the finite scalar-extension/restriction adjunction of coefficientScalarTensorIso.hom. These are equal chain maps T to D_n. No K-flatness, boundedness, completeness or termwise-flatness hypothesis is imposed. The named cone and its map are real constructions from the prescribed augmentations and comparison.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941; scalar tensor units as in sites-modules.tex, Tag 03EK.

proof.text: Compose the actual quotient augmentation of T with the normalized strict tensor-tower isomorphism. This gives a natural transformation from the constant T tower, hence a strict cone with vertex T.

Apply complex hom extensionality and total-tensor generator extensionality. The finite adjunction unit inserts coefficient one. coefficientScalarTensorIso sends the resulting homogeneous pure tensor to the tensor of its two quotient units. The quotient augmentation followed by tensorTowerIso has exactly the same formula, by their unique prescribed generator equations. Hence the maps agree in each degree. Zero complexes, the empty site and n=0 satisfy the same generator equations.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorReductionStrictCone_finiteTranspose (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    let T := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P, Q)
    let D := (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E W).obj (P, Q)
    @Eq (T ⟶ D.obj (op n))
      (((pullbackTensorFiniteAdjunction l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).homEquiv T
        ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
          (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W n)).obj
          (((scalarReductionExtension l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P,
            ((scalarReductionExtension l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
        (coefficientScalarTensorIso l E W n P Q).hom)
      ((tensorReductionStrictCone l E W P Q).π.app (op n))
